spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (बीभत्सते)
1 To bind or tie.
2 To hate, to despise, to loath.
3 To suffer change or affection of the mind.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (बधति बाधयति)
1 To tie, to bind.
2 To kill.

m. (-धः)
1 Killing, slaughter, slaying, murder.
2 A killer, a slaughter.
E.
बध substituted for हन to kill, aff. घञ्.

(ऋ) बाधृ r. 1st cl. (बाधते)
1 To resist, to oppose.
2 To annoy or afflict.

m. (-धः)
1 Opposing, hindering.
2

Annoyance.
3

Refutation arising from incompatibility or contradiction of assigned cause and effect (in logic).
E.
बाध to oppose, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A slaughterer, a killer.
E.
हन changed to बध, and कुन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
What hinders, opposes, pains, &c.
E.
बाध, and वुन् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि)
Wishing death.
E.
बध, and काङ्क्षिन् who wishes.

f. (-म्या)
Intent or desire to kill.
E.
बध, and काम्या desire.

m. (-वी)
A hunter, a fowler, a butcher, &c.
E.
बध killing, and जीविन् who lives by.

n. (-त्रं)
A weapon.
E.
बध to kill, Uṇādi aff. त्रच्.

n. (-ण्डं)
Capital punishment.
E.
बध, and दण्ड punishment.

f. (-ली)
A place of slaughter or execution.
E.
बध killing, स्थल ground.

n. (-नं)
Place of slaughter or execution.
E.
बध killing, स्थान place.

n. (-कं)
Poison.
E.
बध killing, अङ्ग the body, aff. कन्.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Deserving death.
E.
बध, and अर्ह fit for.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Deaf.
E.
बन्ध to bind, (the hearing,) aff. किरन्, deriv. irr.

f. (-धूः)
1 A woman.
2 A wife.
E.
बन्ध to bind, aff. ऊ; it is more usually derived from वह to bear, and is consequently written with the semivowel: see वधू, &c.

mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं)
Effecting or causing death.
E.
बध, and उदर्क future result.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Murderous, felonious, an assassin, a murderer.
E.
बध killing, and उद्यत endeavouring.

m. (-यः)
Instrument or means of putting to death.
E.
बध, and उपाय means.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 Deserving death.
2 Condemned to death.
E.
बध for हन to kill, aff. यत्.

Destruction.
2

Fitness to be killed.
E.
बध्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, बध्यत्व.

f. (-मिः)
Place of public execution.
E.
बध्य, and भूमि site.

n. (-नं)
Place of execution.
E.
बध्य, and स्थान place.

ind.
1 Having tied or bound.
2 Having killed.
E.
बन्ध to tie, or बध to kill, and क्त्वाच् aff.

n. (-ध्रं)
Lead.
f. (-ध्री)
A thong.
E.
बन्ध to bind, aff. ष्ट्रन्; see वर्द्ध and वर्द्धी.

n. (-ध्र्यं)
A shoe, a slipper.
E.
बन्ध to bind or tie, ष्ट्रान् aff.

Pain.
2

Impeding, opposing.
E.
बाध to oppose, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Paining, annoying.
E.
बाध to annoy, and शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being harassed or tormented.
E.
बाध to annoy, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Obstructed, impeded.
2 Pained, tormented.
3 Self-refuted (in logic), contradictory, incompatible.
E.
बाध to oppose, क्त aff.
